doc.summary: Checks if this process can receive custom protocol URLs.
Registers this application as the handler of a URL scheme.

params.name: scheme
params.text: The scheme without "://", e.g. "myapp". It must start with a letter followed by letters, digits, "+", "-" or "."; it is matched case-insensitively.

doc.returns: true if URLs of the scheme are routed to this application after the call; false for an invalid scheme, an undeclared scheme, a write failure, or an unsupported platform.

notes.text:
Platform availability:
- macOS: ⚠️ Declaration check - true when CFBundleURLTypes declares the scheme; re-registers the bundle with LaunchServices, never changes the user's default
- Windows: ✅ Fully supported - writes HKCU\Software\Classes\<scheme> pointing at this executable; returns false in an MSIX package, whose manifest declares it
- Linux: ❌ Not applicable - Always returns false
- Android: ⚠️ Declaration check - true when an activity of this package has a VIEW intent filter for the scheme
- iOS: ⚠️ Declaration check - true when CFBundleURLTypes declares the scheme
- OpenHarmony: ❌ Not applicable - Always returns false
